attchmntText: Alps Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Alps Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The approval covers both Standalone and Consolidated financial statements, including cash flow, related party statements, and statements of assets and liabilities. Limited Review Reports for both Standalone and Consolidated results were issued by O. Aggarwal & Co. The reports highlight an Emphasis of Matter regarding the implementation of a resolution plan approved by the National Company NCLT and its impact on financial results. The company confirmed that segment-wise reporting is not applicable as there is only one reportable segment, the Textile Segment. The summarized results were published in newspapers and are available on the company website.
